run_faiss_auto_tune_demo: run the FAISS auto-tune demo to benchmark index configurations on the SIFT1M dataset
create_fvecs_read_function: create a function that reads FAISS float vector files in fvecs binary format and returns a numpy array

plot_operating_points: plot recall versus search time operating points for FAISS index configurations using matplotlib
